data.name: Brand
data.comment: Federation name shown above the sign-in card.

data.name: SignInTitle
data.comment: Browser title and heading of the dashboard sign-in page.

data.name: Email
data.comment: Label of the email field on the sign-in form.

data.name: Password
data.comment: Label of the password field on the sign-in form.

data.name: RememberMe
data.comment: Label of the "remember me" checkbox on the sign-in form.

data.name: SignIn
data.comment: Text of the sign-in submit button.

data.name: AccountsByAdmin
data.value: Dashboard accounts are created by a federation administrator.
data.comment: Note below the sign-in form: there is no self-service sign-up.

data.name: InvalidSignIn
data.comment: Shown when the email/password pair does not match; deliberately does not say which half was wrong.

data.name: LockedOutTitle
data.comment: Browser title and heading of the account-locked page.

data.name: LockedOutBody
data.value: Too many failed sign-in attempts. This account is locked for 15 minutes.
data.comment: Body text of the account-locked page.

data.name: AccessDeniedTitle
data.comment: Browser title and heading of the access-denied page.

data.name: AccessDeniedBody
data.value: Your account does not have permission to open that part of the dashboard.
data.comment: Body text of the access-denied page.

data.name: NotFoundTitle
data.comment: Browser title and heading of the dashboard 404 page.

data.name: NotFoundBody
data.value: There is nothing at this address.
data.comment: Body text of the dashboard 404 page.

data.name: BackToDashboard
data.comment: Link back to the dashboard shown on the lockout, access-denied, not-found and error pages.

data.name: ErrorTitle
data.comment: Browser title and heading of the dashboard error page.

data.name: ErrorBody
data.value: The request could not be completed. Please try again, or contact the federation IT team if it keeps happening.
data.comment: Body text of the dashboard error page.

data.name: Validation_FilePath
data.value: '{0}' is not a file under {1}/ or {2}/.
data.comment: Shown when a saved file path is not a site-relative /docs or media path.

data.name: Validation_Required
data.comment: Shown when a required dashboard field was left blank.

data.name: Validation_SlugFormat
data.value: Use lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens.
data.comment: Shown when a slug fails the site's slug format rule.

data.name: Validation_SlugReserved
data.value: '{0}' is reserved by the site's own routes.
data.comment: Shown when a page slug collides with a reserved route segment.

data.name: Validation_SlugTaken
data.comment: Shown when a slug is already used by another page or post.

data.name: Validation_NotFound
data.comment: Shown when a save targets an id that no longer exists.

data.name: Validation_LabelBothLanguages
data.value: Every link needs an English and an Arabic label.
data.comment: Shown when a navigation link is missing one of its two labels.

data.name: Validation_Href
data.value: '{0}' is not a link the site can render.
data.comment: Shown when a navigation link's href is not a site path, fragment, mailto/tel, or absolute http(s) URL.

data.name: Validation_BodyEmpty
data.comment: Shown when a news post's body sanitises down to nothing.

data.name: Validation_SettingKey
data.value: '{0}' is not a setting the site reads.
data.comment: Shown when a settings save includes a key the layout does not read.

data.name: Validation_Email
data.comment: Shown when a contact email setting is not a plausible address.
